description_en: Creates a workspace for data warehouse development in Data Management (DMS)
description_zh: 调用CreateLakeHouseSpace接口，在DMS数仓开发中创建新的项目空间
name: CreateLakeHouseSpace

parameters.help_en:
The mode in which the workspace runs. Valid values:

0: basic mode. This mode is unavailable.

1: standard mode
parameters.help_zh:
项目空间模式，取值如下：
0：简单模式，暂不支持。
1：标准模式
parameters.name: mode

parameters.help_en:
The type of the database. Valid values:

14: AnalyticDB for MySQL

18: AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型，当前仅支持：

14：AnalyticDB MySQL版
18：AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版
parameters.name: dw_db_type

parameters.help_en:
The configuration of the workspace. Valid values:

skipManualRunCheck: No security rule check is required in the trial run phase.

skipPublishApprove: No approval is required for publishing and O\&M
parameters.help_zh:
项目空间配置，支持的配置项：
skipManualRunCheck：试运行免安全规则检查。
skipPublishApprove：发布、运维免审批
parameters.name: space_config

parameters.help_en: The ID of the development database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 开发库的数据库ID（DatabaseId），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dev_db_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the production database. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 生产库的数据库ID（DatabaseId），可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: prod_db_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to obtain the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request fails

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request fails
ErrorMessage.example: Invalid parameters: space name、mode、prod db id、db type、config.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.

false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
